description: Skyrim install guard for Codex: protect-bash refuses a delete of the game root, Data, the config folder, a Saves folder, a backup store or the save vault. Codex on Windows runs PowerShell under tool_name Bash, so the hook is passed the word codex. A SessionStart hook prints whether the save vault watcher is running.

hooks.command: py -3.10 -I "$env:USERPROFILE/Projects/save-vault-pinned/tools/save_vault.py" --project "C:/GOG Games/The Elder Scrolls V Skyrim VR" status; exit 0
C:/PROGRA~1/Git/bin/bash.exe "C:/GOG Games/The Elder Scrolls V Skyrim VR/.claude/hooks/protect-bash.sh" codex
